svg.aria-label: The kiln palette: six content hues spaced on a luminance staircase, and four parchment text tiers separated by measured colour difference
svg.text: Six content hues on a luminance staircase
a syntax highlighter can tell them apart by weight alone, before hue is even considered
red kept dark, green kept light, on purpose:
under deuteranopia both collapse toward brown — the L* gap keeps a diff readable
four text tiers separated by chroma as much as luminance
color15 is pure white on purpose —
the hottest point in a kiln fires white.
